# Pull Requests Policy

This is a personal fork published **as-is** under the MIT licence.

Pull requests are not accepted from the public. Only explicitly added collaborators may open pull requests.

For the original extension, see [tscpp/xit-vscode](https://github.com/tscpp/xit-vscode). Otherwise please fork this project and continue development under the MIT licence.

---

> Non-collaborator pull requests will be automatically closed.
